reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000729 (the melody read from 000729a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 3 notes off in 24); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Frederick C. Maker's dates (1844–1927) are from our page for the tune ST. CHRISTOPHER (content/hymns/tunes/st-christopher.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1876. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000729a.nwc). The tune ends on E, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
